title: Data table
summary: A table that sorts, hides columns, selects rows and paginates, with a toolbar slot and an empty state. Use it for any list of records people work through; it replaces the hand-written tables in the provider app.

demos.title: Sorting and columns
demos.note: Click a header to sort ascending, again for descending, a third time to clear. The Columns menu hides any column except the ones marked hideable: false, here the claim number.

demos.title: Selection and pagination
demos.note: Pass onSelectionChange to get row checkboxes; the header checkbox selects the page. Pass pageSize to paginate. The selection is kept across pages and counted in the footer.
